description: This file implements HTTP authentication and authorization mechanisms for the lighttpd server, including support for Basic, Digest, and external authentication schemes. It manages authentication cache, parses authorization headers, and handles various authentication flows.

classes.name: http_auth_cache
classes.description: Structure for caching HTTP authentication entries to improve performance.

classes.name: plugin_config
classes.description: Configuration structure for authentication plugin settings.

classes.name: plugin_data
classes.description: Main plugin data holding defaults and configuration.

classes.name: http_auth_cache_entry
classes.description: Represents individual cached authentication data for a user.

classes.name: data_auth
classes.description: Parsed authentication requirement data associated with a URI prefix.

classes.name: http_auth_digest_params_t
classes.description: Stores parsed parameters from digest authentication headers.

methods.name: http_auth_cache_entry * http_auth_cache_entry_init(const struct http_auth_require_t * const require,const int dalgo,const char * k,const uint32_t klen,const char * username,const uint32_t ulen,const char * pw,const uint32_t pwlen)
methods.description: Initializes a cache entry with user credentials and requirement info.

methods.name: void http_auth_cache_entry_free(void * data)
methods.description: Frees a cache entry, zeroing sensitive data.

methods.name: void http_auth_cache_free(http_auth_cache * ac)
methods.description: Frees the entire authentication cache and its entries.

methods.name: http_auth_cache * http_auth_cache_init(const array * opts)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new authentication cache with options.

methods.name: __attribute_pure__ int http_auth_cache_hash(const struct http_auth_require_t * const require,const char * username,const uint32_t ulen)
methods.description: Computes a hash key for cache lookup based on requirement and username.

methods.name: http_auth_cache_entry * http_auth_cache_query(splay_tree ** const sptree,const int ndx)
methods.description: Queries the cache for an entry given a hash index.

methods.name: void http_auth_cache_insert(splay_tree ** const sptree,const int ndx,void * const data,void (data_free_fn)(void *))
methods.description: Inserts a new entry or replaces an existing one in the cache.

methods.name: handler_t mod_auth_check_basic(request_st * const r,void * p_d,const struct http_auth_require_t * const require,const struct http_auth_backend_t * const backend)
methods.description: Handles Basic HTTP authentication scheme verification.

methods.name: handler_t mod_auth_check_digest(request_st * const r,void * p_d,const struct http_auth_require_t * const require,const struct http_auth_backend_t * const backend)
methods.description: Handles Digest HTTP authentication scheme verification.

methods.name: handler_t mod_auth_check_extern(request_st * const r,void * p_d,const struct http_auth_require_t * const require,const struct http_auth_backend_t * const backend)
methods.description: Handles external authentication where REMOTE_USER is pre-set.

methods.description: Sends a 400 Bad Request response.

methods.name: __attribute_noinline__ handler_t mod_auth_send_401_unauthorized_basic(request_st * const r,const buffer * const realm)
methods.description: Sends a 401 Unauthorized response with WWW-Authenticate header for Basic scheme.

methods.description: Logs an error for misconfigured Basic auth backend.

methods.description: Logs an error for misconfigured Digest auth backend.
